summary.text: Amy Binsfeld is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against independent Christian Ellis.
A business owner, she previously served in the Wisconsin State Assembly from January 2023 to January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Amy Binsfeld was born in Sheboygan, Wisconsin, graduated from Manitowoc Lutheran High School in 1995, and earned an associate degree in paralegal studies from Lakeshore Technical College in 2013.
Her career experience includes working at a family business, Bitter Neumann, and at Olsen Kloet Gunderson & Conway.
Binsfeld defeated Chet Gerlach in the November 8, 2022, general election for Wisconsin State Assembly District 27 and assumed office on January 3, 2023.
In 2024 she ran for re-election in Assembly District 26 and lost to Joe Sheehan, and she left office on January 6, 2025.
She advanced from the Republican primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 9 on August 11, 2026.
